about_the_game:
NieR Re[in]carnation Music Reimagined in Chillout Arrangements!

The beautiful and heartrending melodies of the smartphone title NieR Re[in]carnation are now available in a chillout arrangement album!

This collection features 9 fan-favorite tracks, reinterpreted by 9 talented artists active in Japan and abroad.

The album’s cover illustration is an exclusive new artwork by Momojiro, the illustrator behind the game’s stunning visuals.

Relax and immerse yourself in the soothing chillout sounds of NieR Re[in]carnation.

*NieR Re[in]carnation was the first mobile title in the NieR series, released in February 2021. (The service has since been discontinued.)
